flags.title: L1: the floor plate is 35 m2 of the about 296 m2 the walls span
flags.detail: The walls do not close round the floor, so most of it has no floor plate. The floor plate is made of the rooms the walls close (the bank's rule): where the walls or the facade do not close (gaps at corners, glass that is not built, or walls on a layer that is not built), the rooms between them get no floor and cannot be walked. Check the wall and glass layers on the Layers step; plates from the wall network are a later option.
